list.title: Flows
list.description: Every weighted destination across every campaign's stream sets, in one place. A flow's "View statistics" only shows history recorded since its id was last minted — opening its stream set's own editor and saving resets that, even without changing the flow itself; a quick pause/activate toggle does not.
list.emptyDescription: Flows are created inside a campaign's Stream Sets — open a campaign to add one.

row.viewStatisticsTooltip: View statistics — resets whenever this flow's stream set is next saved
